name: bugcorpus
title_zh: 踩过的坑自动变成常驻检测器，下次改代码它先拦你
tagline_zh: 同一个 bug 修完还会再犯，因为修的是那一处代码，不是那类错误。它把每次事故沉淀成一条确定性检测规则。
tagline_en: Fixing one bug doesn't stop the next one. This turns each incident into a deterministic rule that catches the.
desc_en: Compiler from historical bugs into permanent deterministic detectors
why_zh: 检测逻辑从真实故障里长出来，不是凭空想象的规则清单；每条都能追溯到具体那次翻车，误报有据可查。
why_en: Rules are grown from real incidents, not invented checklists. Every detector traces back to a specific failure, so false.
limit_zh: 它只沉淀你亲手喂进去的历史 bug，没有现成规则库可白嫖；bug 记录得先整理成结构化条目，否则编译不出检测器。
limit_en: Only compiles bugs you feed it; no ready-made rule library. Input must be structured incident records or nothing compiles.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Every bug you've hit becomes a permanent detector that.
